$comment: Desired state for the GitHub repository page. GitHub reads none of this from the tree, so `pnpm github:setup` applies it through the REST API. Keep it reviewable: one key here is one field on the settings page.
description: Self-hosted AI development orchestration platform. A backlog becomes delegated work that AI coding agents execute, with real repositories, branches, pull requests and an audit trail. TypeScript monorepo: NestJS/Fastify services, PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream.
